name: Samsara
summary: Fleet operations platform: vehicle gateways, dash cams, GPS tracking, compliance, and a route planning and dispatch product. Its REST API models the planning loop an outside system can drive (create a plan, bulk-upsert orders with appointment windows, read back the routes the planner produced) and emits route-stop ETA and early/late arrival webhooks in beta. One scm job is claimed; route optimization is deliberately NOT claimed, and the profile says which sentence the vendor would have to publish for it to be.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-27, no credentials: REST fleet/vehicles 401; OpenAPI 200 to anyone. MCP, documented since 2026-09-16 at mcp.samsara.com/v2/mcp: initialize 401 Bearer naming RFC 9728 metadata; the auth server cloud.samsara.com advertises registration, PKCE S256, one scope mcp_read.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-27: no listed surface prices a request or speaks a 402. Express Order Terms (web-store orders): a recurring credit card or direct debit charge. Terms of Service 6.1 (Order Forms): wire transfer unless the Order Form says otherwise. No figure published; quotes by fleet size.

jobs.summary: Own-fleet telemetry, not carrier feeds: the vendor documents RouteStopEtaUpdated and RouteStopEarlyLateArrival webhooks (both labelled beta) and Route Stop ETA and Out of Route alert triggers, with route execution that lets a dispatcher "manage exceptions in real time".
